security_audit.summary: Most static command, script, blocker, and obfuscation alerts are false positives caused by markdown fences, regex exec, CSS, comments, and an SRI hash. Confirmed issues are limited to low-severity external CDN and font dependencies in generated browser artifacts. No prompt injection or data-exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.issue: Generated HTML loads p5.js and Google Fonts from external domains.
remediation.suggestion: Bundle approved local assets or document the required external domains and integrity controls for users.

remediation.issue: The viewer template encourages direct reuse of third-party browser resources.
remediation.suggestion: Provide an offline template option for users who need privacy, reproducibility, or locked supply chains.

content.value_statement: Creative teams need repeatable generative art workflows that still leave room for interpretation. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to create philosophies, p5.js algorithms, and interactive viewers.
actual_capabilities: Drafts a concise algorithmic philosophy before implementation.
Guides creation of p5.js sketches with seeded randomness.
Provides an HTML viewer template with sidebar controls.
Defines adjustable parameters, seed navigation, and reset behavior.
Includes JavaScript structure for palettes, entities, utilities, and image export.
limitations: Generated HTML depends on external CDN resources unless assets are bundled locally.
The viewer template contains placeholder algorithm sections that must be completed.
It does not automatically test visual output, browser performance, or accessibility.
Generated creative code still needs manual review before publication.

best_practices: Start with a clear computational philosophy before writing the p5.js implementation.
Keep every random choice seeded so users can reproduce useful variations.
Review generated HTML and external dependencies before sharing the artifact.

Do not publish generated browser code without checking dependencies and performance.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates a generative art concept, p5.js implementation guidance, and an interactive HTML viewer.

faq.question: Does it generate finished images?
faq.answer: It focuses on code-driven artwork. Images can be exported from the resulting browser artifact.

faq.question: Can results be reproduced?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow emphasizes seeded randomness so the same seed should recreate the same composition.

faq.question: Does the viewer work offline?
faq.answer: Not by default. The template loads p5.js and fonts from external URLs unless they are bundled locally.

faq.question: Can I customize the controls?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill expects controls to match the specific algorithm and its meaningful parameters.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
